MappingPage - baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
|-- Composition and injected boundaries
|   |-- MappingPocPage({ services }: { services: MappingServices })
|   |   `-- Supplies MappingServicesContext to MappingWorkspacePage.
|   |-- useMappingServices(): diagrams, canvasHistory, workspaceStorage
|   |   `-- Uses injected services; their external lifetime ownership is unspecified.
|   `-- new CanvasWorkspace(diagramService, canvasHistory)
|       `-- The page creates the registry and disposes it on cleanup.
|-- CanvasWorkspace manages live sessions
|   |-- private storeState; subscriptions; persistenceListeners
|   |   `-- Publishes readable drafts, change versions and dirty scene IDs.
|   |-- setDrafts(value)
|   |   |-- Seeds create CanvasSession instances; metadata updates reuse sessions.
|   |   `-- Replacement removes subscriptions and disposes the old session.
|   |-- controllers: Map<string, MappingDocumentController>
|   |   `-- References session controllers for page and agent commands.
|   `-- copyDocument(input)
|       |-- Calls controller.forkHistory(canvas) and setDrafts(...).
|       `-- Clears selection and controls; copied chat requests stop pending.
|-- CanvasSession publishes controller state
|   |-- new MappingDocumentController(document, canvas, ...)
|   |   `-- Domain state remains managed by the controller.
|   |-- readable(store): getState, getInitialState, subscribe
|   |   |-- Private stores expose immutable references for subscribers.
|   |   `-- document; presentation; selection; controls; geometry; status
|   |-- statusOf(snapshot)
|   |   `-- Dirty state requires scene, edges and name versus saved baselines.
|   `-- dispose()
|       `-- Releases the controller subscription and commit listeners.
|-- Document and view are distinct state
|   |-- MappingGridDocument: scene, edges, sections, jumps?
|   |   `-- The scene supplies grid geometry and diagram values.
|   |-- MappingCanvasState: selection, diagramViews?, display, controls
|   |   |-- SelectionState retains membership and insertion order.
|   |   |-- SelectionItem: id, displayNodeId, region?
|   |   |   `-- An absent region selects the whole diagram instance.
|   |   `-- controls: activeBoxId, selectionFocusId, activeThreadId, surfaces
|   |       `-- Focus and action surfaces have separate state from membership.
|   `-- canvasDisplayNodes(document, canvas, version, cell, endpointBounds)
|       |-- Produces a cloned read registry over existing state.
|       |-- CanvasDisplayNode = grid variant | floating variant
|       `-- Grid uses cells; floating panes and derived arrows use pixels.
|-- Page navigation, editing and discovery
|   |-- open(id); jumpTo(target); revealSearchResult(result)
|   |   `-- Search reveal checks content revision and hash before focusing.
|   |-- search.sync(searchDocuments)
|   |   `-- Requires saved revisions, visible drafts and the current proposal.
|   |-- handleAgentCommand(command)
|   |   `-- Dispatches reads and edits through the workspace controllers.
|   |-- diagramEdits.open({ canvasId, documentId, nodeId, label })
|   |   `-- DiagramEditComposer receives the page-created coordinator.
|   `-- save(); create(); remove(id)
|       `-- Project saves capture history and update acknowledged baselines.
|-- SourcePaneViewState manages live viewport state
|   |-- private entries; cameras; captures; timers; listeners
|   |   `-- bind(...) gives each mounted reader a symbol-guarded connection.
|   |-- captureDisplay(documentId, display); captureCamera(documentId, fallback)
|   |   `-- Samples matching pane scroll and camera state for persistence.
|   `-- prune(documentId, display); flush(); dispose()
|       `-- Removes stale panes, emits pending changes and clears timers.
|-- Workspace persistence and coordinated transfers
|   |-- new WorkspacePersistence(workspace, storage.records, projectId, viewState)
|   |   `-- The page installs the adapter after workspace loading completes.
|   |-- capture(): MappingWorkspaceSnapshot
|   |   `-- Collects histories, document state, captured display and cameras.
|   |-- transfer(destinationChoice); undo(id, redo)
|   |   `-- Coordinate participants and guard busy or changed canvases.
|   `-- publishTransfer(workspace)
|       `-- Awaits storage.save(workspace) before installWorkspace(workspace).
`-- Rendering and resource lifetimes
    |-- DraggableDiagramCanvas > MappingPocSelectionCanvas
    |   `-- Passes each session, active status, focus and command callbacks.
    |-- mountedDocuments: Set<string>
    |   `-- Previously visited draft views remain mounted while hidden.
    |-- MappingDiagramExplorer; DiagramSearchPanel; ChangeSessionPreview
    |   `-- Explorer and search consume draft documents and page metadata.
    `-- Cleanup calls diagramEdits.dispose(), search.dispose(), workspace.dispose().
        `-- Page-created storage is flushed then disposed; view state is also released.
